manifest.name: @skyrocks/dsh-deepseek-cost
manifest.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: 输入框下方常驻显示官网账号余额，以及本轮 / 今日 / 本周 / 本月 / 累计花费
manifest.author: skyrocks (https://github.com/skyrocks)

bundle.text:
# dsh-deepseek-cost 插件行：作为 bundle patch 自动注入 profile 组合。
# 安装后由 `dsh plugin add` 的 reconcile 步骤登记为 profile layer，无需手改用户层。
# 需要调整时，在 profile 的 cordis.patch.yml 里按 id 覆盖 config：
#   - id: deepseek-cost
#     config:
#       cacheMs: 60000        # 官网数据缓存
#       prices:               # 仅影响「本轮」的本地估算
#         deepseek-flash: { input: 2, cacheRead: 0.04, output: 8 }
- insert:
    - id: deepseek-cost
      name: "@skyrocks/dsh-deepseek-cost"

readme.text:
在 **DeepSeek Harness** 的对话输入框下方，常驻显示 **DeepSeek 账号余额** 与 **本轮 / 今日 / 本周 / 本月 / 累计** 花费，悬浮看明细，点击立即刷新。 显示区域与样式沿用 [`dsh-go-quota`](https://github.com/skyrocks/dsh-go-quota) 的 输入框下方 dock（同一 `conversation.composer.dock` 槽位、同一套主题变量）。

> 以上为界面示意图，实际样式跟随 DSH 主题（明 / 暗）。

```text
DS  -¥0.49 │ 轮 ¥0.02 │ 日 ¥0 │ 周 ¥0 │ 月 ¥18.77 │ 总 ¥129.65
```

悬浮：

```text
┌ DeepSeek 余额与花费            更新 17:20 ┐
│ 余额      -¥0.49                        │
│   充值 -¥0.49 · 赠送 ¥0                 │
│ 本轮      ¥0.02    12.3k in · 0.8k out  │

> **只在官方模型下显示。** 当前会话的 provider 是 `deepseek-official` /
> `deepseek-account` 时才出现；用 `opencode-go`、自建中转等订阅渠道时整条隐藏。

---

| 显示项 | 来源 |
| --- | --- |
| 余额 | **官网账号** `GET /api/v0/users/get_user_summary`（充值 + 赠送钱包，透支显示为负数） |
| 累计 | 同一个接口的 `total_costs`：**官网账号累计消费**，含其它客户端与更早历史 |
| 今日 / 本周 / 本月 | **官网账号** `GET /api/v0/usage/by_api_key/cost`，按天时间桶求和 |
| 本轮 | **本地估算**：当前会话最新一轮的 assistant usage × 官方价目表（官网没有这个粒度） |

- 今日 / 本周 / 本月 按本机时区切天，周一为一周起点；金额与官网「用量」页一致。
- 本轮是唯一算出来的值，也是唯一不与官网一一对应的值。
- 未登录官网账号时：余额回退到 DSH 配置的 API Key → `/user/balance`，
  日/周/月/累计显示 `—`（官网数据需要登录态）。

readme.section: 官方价目表（人民币 / 每百万 tokens）
readme.text:
仅用于**本轮**估算：

| 模型 | 缓存命中 | 缓存未命中 | 输出 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `deepseek-flash`（含旧名 `deepseek-v4-flash*`） | 高峰 0.04 / 空闲 0.02 | 高峰 2 / 空闲 1 | 高峰 8 / 空闲 4 |
| `deepseek-v4-pro` | 高峰 0.30 / 空闲 0.15 | 高峰 9 / 空闲 4.5 | 高峰 27 / 空闲 13.5 |

高峰＝北京时间周一至周五 9:00–12:00、14:00–18:00（法定节假日无法本地判断，按高峰算）。

设置 →「插件」→「添加插件」，粘贴：

```
github:skyrocks/dsh-deepseek-cost
```

然后 **完全退出 DSH 再打开**（Host 插件只在启动时加载），选一个官方 DeepSeek 模型，
输入框下方就会出现 `DS 余额 … ｜ 轮 … ｜ 日 …`。

> 包名是 `@skyrocks/dsh-deepseek-cost`。npm 上另有一个同名包 `dsh-deepseek-cost`
> （作者 miaoxintechnology），与本项目无关；当前只通过 GitHub 分发。

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:skyrocks/dsh-deepseek-cost
```

`desktop` 是桌面版 profile；`dsh web` 换成 `--profile web`。装完同样要完全退出并重启。

在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里按 id 覆盖：

```yaml
- id: deepseek-cost
  config:
    cacheMs: 60000
    prices:

| 字段 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `refreshMs` | `30000` | 客户端轮询间隔（毫秒） |
| `cacheMs` | `60000` | 官网数据缓存（毫秒）；每次刷新最多 4 个请求 |
| `prices` | 官方人民币价目表 | **只影响本轮估算**：每 100 万 tokens，支持 `{peak, offPeak}` 双档或单档 |
| `currency` | `CNY` | 官网数据不可用时的展示货币 |
| `cnyToUsd` | `0.139` | 展示货币为美元时的折算率（只影响本轮） |
| `timeoutMs` | `15000` | 单次 HTTP 超时 |
| `clientVersion` | `1.0.0` | 发给官网的 `x-client-version` |

**为什么没显示？**
当前会话的模型不是官方路由（`deepseek-official` / `deepseek-account`）时不会显示。

**余额、累计和官网一致吗？**
一致，直接读官网同源接口，不做二次计算。累计是账号维度，包含其它客户端的历史。

**「本轮」为什么和别的不一样？**
官网没有按轮次的数据，这一项只能是本地按官方价目表估算，会随每一步落账更新。

**日/周/月显示 `—`？**
官网数据需要登录态：设置 →「账户」里登录 DeepSeek 账号即可；未登录时只有 API Key 余额可用。

```sh
node test/smoke.mjs     # 纯逻辑回归：价目表 / 高峰判定 / 分桶 / 官网响应解析 / codec
```

结构：

| 文件 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `index.js` | Host 服务：官网数据读取与缓存、本轮折叠 |
| `official.js` | 官网接口：`get_user_summary` / `usage_by_api_key_cost` 的请求与解析 |
| `ledger.js` | 纯函数：事件 → 账本记录、按轮次分桶 |
| `pricing.js` | 纯函数：官方价目表、高峰判定、四桶计价 |
| `balance.js` | 纯函数：API Key 余额解析、凭据引用收集 |
| `client.js` | 客户端 dock、悬浮明细、官方路由门控 |
| `typert.host.js` | `deepseekCost/read`、`deepseekCost/refresh` 的 wire 清单 |

[简体中文](README.md) | English

A **DeepSeek Harness** plugin that keeps your **DeepSeek account balance** and your
**current turn / today / this week / this month / all-time** spend visible under the
conversation composer. Hover for details, click to refresh.

The dock reuses the same composer slot and visual language as
[`dsh-go-quota`](https://github.com/skyrocks/dsh-go-quota).
> Illustrations only; the real dock follows the DSH light/dark theme. ```text DS -¥0.49 │ 轮 ¥0.02 │ 日 ¥0 │ 周 ¥0 │ 月 ¥18.77 │ 总 ¥129.65 ```

> **Only shown for official models.** The dock appears when the session's provider is
> `deepseek-official` / `deepseek-account`, and stays hidden for subscription
> routes such as `opencode-go`, which never consume the DeepSeek balance.

---

| Value | Source |
| --- | --- |
| Balance | **Platform account** — `GET /api/v0/users/get_user_summary`, topped-up + granted wallets (overdraft is shown negative) |
| All-time | Same endpoint's `total_costs`: account-wide cumulative spend |
| Today / week / month | **Platform account** — `GET /api/v0/usage/by_api_key/cost`, summed over daily buckets |
| Current turn | **Local estimate** — the session's latest turn usage × the official price table (the Platform has no per-turn figure) |

- Day boundaries use the host timezone; weeks start on Monday.
- The current turn is the only computed value and the only one without a one-to-one
  counterpart on the Platform.
- Signed out? The balance falls back to the DeepSeek API key route
  (`/user/balance`), and today/week/month/all-time show `—` instead of a guess.

Used only for the current-turn estimate:

| Model | Cache hit | Cache miss | Output |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `deepseek-flash` (incl. legacy `deepseek-v4-flash*`) | peak 0.04 / off-peak 0.02 | peak 2 / off-peak 1 | peak 8 / off-peak 4 |
| `deepseek-v4-pro` | peak 0.30 / off-peak 0.15 | peak 9 / off-peak 4.5 | peak 27 / off-peak 13.5 |

Peak = Beijing time, Monday–Friday 09:00–12:00 and 14:00–18:00 (public holidays cannot be
detected locally and are billed as peak).

Settings → Plugins → Add plugin, then paste:

```
github:skyrocks/dsh-deepseek-cost
```

Then **quit DSH completely and reopen it** (host plugins load at startup) and pick an
official DeepSeek model; the dock appears under the composer.

> The package name is `@skyrocks/dsh-deepseek-cost`. A different, unrelated package
> named `dsh-deepseek-cost` exists on npm (published by miaoxintechnology); this
> project is currently distributed through GitHub only.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:skyrocks/dsh-deepseek-cost
```

Use `--profile web` for a `dsh web` profile. Fully quit and relaunch DSH afterwards.

Override by id in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: deepseek-cost
  config:
    cacheMs: 60000
    prices:

| Field | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `refreshMs` | `30000` | Client poll interval (ms) |
| `cacheMs` | `60000` | Platform data cache (ms); a refresh costs at most 2 requests |
| `prices` | Official CNY table | **Current-turn only**: per 1M tokens, `{peak, offPeak}` or a single tier |
| `currency` | `CNY` | Display currency when Platform data is unavailable |
| `cnyToUsd` | `0.139` | Rate used when displaying USD (current turn only) |
| `timeoutMs` | `15000` | Per-request timeout |
| `clientVersion` | `1.0.0` | `x-client-version` sent to the Platform |

**Nothing shows up?**
The session is not using an official route (`deepseek-official` / `deepseek-account`).

**Does the balance match the website?**
Yes — same endpoint, no re-computation. All-time is account-wide and includes other clients.

**Why is the current turn different from the rest?**
The Platform exposes no per-turn data, so this one value is estimated locally with the
official price table and updates as each step settles.

**Why do today/week/month show `—`?**
Those require the Platform login (Settings → Account). Signed out, only the API-key
balance is available.

```sh
node test/smoke.mjs     # unit tests: pricing, peak hours, bucketing, Platform parsing, codec
```

| File | Role |
| --- | --- |
| `index.js` | Host service: Platform reads, cache, current-turn fold |
| `official.js` | Platform endpoints: request + response parsing |
| `ledger.js` | Pure: events → ledger entries, per-turn buckets |
| `pricing.js` | Pure: official price table, peak detection, four-bucket costing |
| `balance.js` | Pure: API-key balance parsing, credential refs |
| `client.js` | Client dock, hover panel, official-route gating |
| `typert.host.js` | Wire manifest for `deepseekCost/read` and `deepseekCost/refresh` |
